item.text: {"summary":"EV004 reports a valid unrestricted n=31 witness with E=75 and b=7 after 100,000 evaluations. This establishes an achievable energy, not global optimality or superiority over skew search.","evidence_strength":"empirical","limitation":"Only one seed and budget were tested. The unrestricted run used effective_skew_fraction=0.5, so it is not a purely non-skew baseline. Budget truncation and witness validation provide no optimality certificate.","next_question":"How does a skew-restricted n=31, seed=11 run perform under the same 100,000-evaluation budget and matched search parameters?"}
